notes.title: Update 1D
notes.notes:
This update brings some fixes for bugs in the game. 

Changes:

Birds are chirping quieter now.
Added missing colliders.


Bug Fixes:

Visual bug when loading from the menu fixed.
Preface pausing fixed.
Adjustment of all flags in the game.
Fixes for a 5:4 resolution ratio.


We are constantly working on improving the game and we thank you for your feedback.

notes.title: Update 1C
notes.notes:
This update includes elements that will help you understand the gameplay better as it brings lots of fixes for bugs and issues. 

Changes:

Crystals are now more visible.
"Give up" button has been improved.
Now you can interact with objects even if the phone is up.
Preface animation reworked.
New hint has been added to the starting location.


Bug Fixes:

Zero wealth ending fixed.
Ending on the Concert Location fixed.
Concert Location quest controls were changed.
All flags were fixed.
Fixes for a 5:4 resolution ratio.
All of the musician's quests have been calibrated.
Freshy Slashy bottle disappearing in the subway was fixed.
Pause menu now works on the final accommodation locations.
Phone volume is now fully adjustable by sound effects setting.
The interaction icon no longer appears when approaching the first statue in the love maze without a rose.
LODs fixes.
Texts edits.
Other fixes.


We are constantly working on improving the game and we thank you for your feedback.

notes.title: Release date
notes.notes:
Dear friends! After a considerable amount of time spent on the development, we are happy to inform you that the game now has an official release date: 09.09.2020! 

Please check out the updated game description and screenshots, because a lot of things have changed during this time. 

Also, there will be a new trailer soon, stay tuned!
